posts.name: Jeysie
posts.cooked:
So Vengeance got its first look on this week's Sentinels Live stream with Team Villain Mode being shown... gotta admit I was pausing every minute or so to get to gawk at all the artwork and flavor text for the villain cards since I don't own any of the "cardboard & ink" sets.

I'm impressed that what has got to be a pretty chaotic setup has been streamlined pretty nicely in the UI. I'm going to be eager to get my hands on this one. I'm looking forward to Parse for the heroes, too, as I like the look of her flavor and mechanics from what I've seen on the wiki.

posts.name: MindWanderer
posts.cooked: I'm looking forward to it, too.  I own the physical copy, but don't get to play it much because it takes too long and my friends get confused with so much going on.  (I'm kind of not looking forward to playing on my phone, though--I'll easily lose track.)  The heroes are fantastic, though: Parse is a superb controller-type, the only one who can destroy a card as it's on the way to the table, with great deck control and removal besides.  The Naturalist is just a brutal damage-dealer with some nice defensive options.  And The Sentinels deal some heavy damage, too; they're a little vulnerable to mass damage but have great damage mitigation options, to the point where I very rarely end up low on HP with them.  (KNYFE is a strong attacker, too, but I haven't played her personally, and she's so simple I'm not sure there's any advantage to using her over, say, Ra.)
